name: replay
description: Turn a macOS screen recording into a reviewable, executable workflow.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @replay/ir && npm run build -w @replay/pipeline && npm run build -w @replay/compilers && npm run build -w @replay/runner
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:native && npm run build -w @replay/test-app && npm run build -w @replay/desktop
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:native
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @replay/test-app && npm run test:e2e -w @replay/compilers
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @replay/desktop
